Local changes in xatlas.cpp (marked RayTrophi):
- Empty chart boundary: use all supplied points for the hull, or a finite empty box.
- Planar-region growth: compare each candidate to the seed normal as well as its neighbor.
These failure modes were identified during the SculptForge UV audit; downloaded code is
the MIT upstream, not SculptForge's GPL AutoUv/UV solver/editor implementation.
